psychological_meaning: Amazon green evokes feelings of nature, growth, and tranquility. It represents balance, harmony, and a connection to the environment. This color is often associated with health, healing, and renewal, offering a sense of peace and well-being. It also symbolizes prosperity and stability, lending an aura of sophistication and grounding.
